resolutions.63: Keep semilya: Wolff similya explicitly includes seedling, especially for transplanting. Rarity/spelling variation is not a defect.
resolutions.68: Keep hulagway: dictionary allows a mental image/description and the key context is clear. Earlier narrowing-to-picture suspicion is withdrawn.
resolutions.70: Keep semilya seedling distractor on the same positive lexical authority as record63.
resolutions.73: Keep putot/usbong: bud usage is attested and the potato-eye comparison preserves the English distinction.
resolutions.78: Keep titip: Wolff títip means very steep. Earlier statement that it was incorrect was false; no gradient rewrite is justified.
resolutions.79: Keep lungag: a hole/opening in the barrier can be the wave gap. Earlier preference for gintang was stylistic, not a proven defect.
